decks.title: Испанский язык: базовые глаголы
decks.description: Сорок глаголов на каждый день: настоящее время, примеры и упражнения на слух.

invariants: Private authenticated routes; guest is 401; invalid token is 401; responses no-store/Vary Authorization. Profile available only when events or for-you enabled; recommendation route additionally requires catalog and for-you enabled. Disabled routes 404 before body/query parsing.

Client cannot send account, deck/revision ids, query text, arbitrary rank version, or server lifecycle kinds. Exact fields; commands UUIDv4/v7; positions null or 1..1000; event kind/surface/version allowlists; exposures <=48 distinct listed public codes, one aggregate impression per item.

Raw events use PostgreSQL 18 uuidv7() and monthly UTC partitioning, primary key (occurred_at,event_id), account/time index. No deck/revision FK delaying immutable GC. No query text column or query logging. Guests are not recorded.

Current month plus previous 12 retained; create next two in advance; remove older whole partitions with DROP (no raw row DELETE retention). Maintenance remains enabled when recording disabled, so existing personal events expire. Bound lock_timeout/statement_timeout transactionally and retry through platform.jobs.
Exposure aggregate is keyed by day, deck, surface, rank_version (no account, no raw event). Position is event-only. Replays use command_receipt. Global anonymous counters remain on profile reset.

Profile row/account lock serializes reset, selection, incremental signals and nightly rebuild. Reset removes explicit and inferred interests and old recommendation events, advances signals_since; pre-reset copies, sessions, goal and queued old computations cannot return. New signals after reset contribute.

Interest max20; chips > copies > study > views > goal. Profile includes topic names and selected/inferred split, no weight. Goal enum only through local topic mapping, without private deck texts. First profile starts at policy activation/no prior raw events; existing copies and optional goal may contribute until a reset establishes a strict new boundary.

Nightly job pages active profiles by account key (30-day activity), bounded slices, queries account/time indexes with bounded event window. Copy increments interest in same transaction. All lifecycle events server-side and only for successful new effective transitions; no events on replay, guest, own/private source or disabled recording.

Recommendations union <=20 per top3 interest topics +20 new +20 global, dedupe <=100, exclude own authored decks and live existing copies including detached copies, use current listed rows only. Score exactly score*(1+0.8*interest)*(language match?1:0.3); no confident language preference => no penalty.

First10 strictly <=2 same author or leaf topic, never relax to fill. Last2 of12 exploratory (new or outside top3), reserve before exploit selection, fewer when catalogue cannot provide12. Hide if <4 eligible decks in interest topics, no interest or fewer4 output. Explanation refers to strongest contributing topic, not an arbitrary catalogue topic.

Recommendation cursor contains only opaque query/account/profile/generation binding and integer list offset, never score/rank/interest weight. Expired generation/profile =>412. Stable ties by public code; only known audience values through AudienceCounts.

Sort for-you is offered/default only to authenticated readers when server permits; shelves remain default page with For you first; explicit for-you filters/search use recommendations endpoint. No text persisted in telemetry; best-effort telemetry never blocks navigation.
